About the practice

A thoughtful, collaborative space to be heard.

I'm Katie Lynn Brodie, MS, LMFT, a California-licensed Marriage and Family Therapist with 16 years of experience. I work collaboratively with clients to better understand what they're experiencing, recognize unhelpful patterns, and practice skills that support lasting change.

My areas of focus include anxiety, depression, substance-use concerns, grief and loss, and relationship transitions. I aim to offer a warm, respectful space where you can speak openly and work toward goals that are meaningful to you.

How I can help

Therapy tailored to your needs.

Sessions are collaborative and focused on helping you build insight and practical coping skills.

Anxiety & emotional regulation

Learn to recognize triggers, respond to anxious thoughts, and build steadier emotional patterns.

Depression & motivation

Explore mood, strengthen coping strategies, and identify realistic steps toward greater engagement.

Grief, loss & transitions

Make space for grief and uncertainty while adjusting to a significant life change.

Substance-use concerns

Explore the role substances may play in your life and identify goals and supports for change.

Relationship changes

Work through breakups, changing family dynamics, communication challenges, and boundaries.

Stress & personal growth

Build self-awareness and develop tools that align with your values and everyday demands.

My approach

Progress at a pace that feels right for you.

Therapy isn't one-size-fits-all. We'll work together to clarify your goals, notice patterns, and identify practical strategies you can use outside of sessions. You bring your lived experience; I bring a collaborative, professional perspective.

Whether you're navigating a difficult season or looking to make a meaningful change, the process starts with a conversation.
